heading: Aggregate loan, guarantee, and insurance authority

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Export-Import Bank of the United States shall not have outstanding at any one time loans, guarantees, and insurance in an aggregate amount in excess of the applicable amount.

children.heading: Applicable amount defined
children.text: In this subsection, the term “applicable amount”, for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2027, means $135,000,000,000.

children.heading: Freezing of lending cap if default rate is 2 percent or more
children.text: If the rate calculated under section 635g(g)(1) of this title is 2 percent or more for a quarter, the Bank may not exceed the amount of loans, guarantees, and insurance outstanding on the last day of that quarter until the rate calculated under section 635g(g)(1) of this title is less than 2 percent.

children.heading: Subject to appropriations
children.text: All spending and credit authority provided under this subchapter shall be effective for any fiscal year only to such extent or in such amounts as are provided in appropriation Acts.

tree.heading: Reserve requirement
tree.text: The Bank shall build to and hold in reserve, to protect against future losses, an amount that is not less than 5 percent of the aggregate amount of disbursed and outstanding loans, guarantees, and insurance of the Bank.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than March 31 of each fiscal year, the President of the United States shall determine whether the authority available to the Bank for such fiscal year will be sufficient to meet the Bank’s needs, particularly those needs arising from—
increases in the level of exports unforeseen at the time of the original budget request for such fiscal year;
any increased foreign export credit subsidies; or
the lack of progress in negotiations to reduce or eliminate export credit subsidies.

children.heading: In general
children.text: If the President of the United States finds that the amount of direct loan authority or guarantee authority available to the Bank for the fiscal year involved exceeds the amount which will be necessary to carry out the Bank’s functions consistent with the availability of qualified applications and limitations imposed by law during such year, the President of the United States shall promptly transmit to the Congress a request for legislation to eliminate the amount of such excess direct loan, loan guarantee, or insurance authority.

children.heading: Continued availability of authority
children.text: The Bank shall continue to make remaining amounts of its authority available for the fiscal year involved, in accordance with its practices and the requirements of this subchapter, unless otherwise directed pursuant to law.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 6 of act July 31, 1945, ch. 341, was renumbered section 5 and is classified to section 635d of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2015 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 114–94, div. E, title LI, § 51002(b), Dec. 4, 2015, 129 Stat. 1763, provided that: “The amendment made by subsection (a) [amending this section] shall take effect on the date that is one year after the date of the enactment of this Act [Dec. 4, 2015].”

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1978 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 95–630 effective Nov. 10, 1978, see section 1917 of Pub. L. 95–630, set out as a note under section 635 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1954 Amendment
notes.text: For effective date of amendment by act Aug. 9, 1954, see note set out under section 635a of this title.
